author: DuckButTurttle
text: TightVNC Viewer 2.8.88 has a pre-auth RCE with a public PoC, no CVE: a malicious VNC server, or anyone reaching a viewer in Listening Mode on TCP 5500, gets code execution. Fixed in 2.8.89+ and 4.0.2; not exploited. Source: SSD Secure Disclosure

author: SpectraAudit
text: VOLTA: When Infostealers Use AI to Identify High-Value Victims. A newly discovered Windows infostealer, VOLTA-AUTODOXER, steals browser passwords, cookies, payment details, crypto wallet data and authentication tokens, and uses AI to pick high-value victims.

author: kevalcodes
text: The PolinRider supply-chain attack targets GitHub & npm. It hijacks dev accounts & injects loaders into Tailwind & Next config files. Run scans, audit PRs, & rotate tokens now!

author: S2W_DailyThreat
text: [INITIAL ACCESS] "marlanwg" claims to sell a 0-day and full network access to Indonesia's DJP (Directorate General of Taxes) on DarkForums. Actor advertises an unauthenticated RCE 0-day granting root across the e-Form system.

author: audiee_ai
text: Trigger.dev (platform for durable AI agents and workflows) says an attacker got environment variables from some customer organizations. Those variables likely hold model/AI provider and database keys. Rotate them today, even if no email came.

author: stretchcloud
text: Trigger.dev disclosed Sunday that an attacker got into environment variables for a subset of its organizations. The company builds infrastructure for durable AI agents and workflows, so what got touched sits underneath other people's agents: API keys, webhook secrets.

author: KrakowiakK
text: AI in short: Full account takeover in ChatGPT HTML previews, chained through MathLive's virtual keyboard. $5,000 bounty. Brazilian court sanctions lawyers for prompt injection in a court filing.

author: BytesNora
text: SecBoard Daily: Alpine Linux rebuilds GitLab after attempted RCE attack (CVE-2026-97229, actively exploited).

author: stym_exe
text: Ukraine's Air Alert app was hijacked around 22:47 on Sunday 1 Nov and pushed false radiation, chemical and street-fighting threat alerts for Kyiv for about an hour; hours later Russia's own alert app was hit too.

author: itsjusttu_
text: Polymarket suffered a supply chain attack on October 29. Attackers compromised a script from DebugBear, a third-party website monitoring provider; the malicious code hijacked logged-in sessions, sold traders' positions, and moved the proceeds out.

author: markgadala
text: Hackers Are Actively Exploiting a Critical Drupal E-Commerce Vulnerability. Online Stores at Risk. A highly critical security vulnerability affecting Drupal Commerce is now being actively exploited by attackers.

author: 0xnut6
text: BTCPay Server told operators to shut down at 22:25 UTC Sunday, yet its own servers on v2.4.7 were not touched. Lead developer @NicolasDorier says the swept instances so far look like ones still running versions before 2.4.2.

author: SecAlertsCo
text: Windows Shell command injection was actively exploited in October, while unauthenticated flaws in FortiMail and GitLab opened direct paths to critical systems.

author: toordog
text: PHP2Shell is being actively exploited. Two critical PHP flaws let attackers run code on a server with no login. Fixes only cover PHP 8.2 and newer. Older versions have no real fix: they need an upgrade.

author: Soar_Infosec
text: If you run Linux servers, a kernel bug called Fragnesia is being actively exploited (CVE-2026-46300). CISA added it to the KEV list Oct 28 and gave federal agencies until Oct 31. It's being chained with the PHP2Shell bugs to plant PHP webshells and run commands as root.

author: triggerdotdev
text: Trigger.dev security incident (Nov 1): an attacker gained unauthorized access to environment variables for a subset of organizations. Exploit blocked; impacted account owners emailed with mitigation steps. https://trigger.dev/blog/security-incident-nov-2026

author: Threatpingapp
text: Actively exploited: CVE-2026-111357 in Ivanti Connect Secure · CVSS 7.0. Ivanti Connect Secure Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability

author: Threatpingapp
text: Actively exploited: CVE-2026-118527 in Ivanti Connect Secure. Ivanti Connect Secure Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers Vulnerability.

author: RoundtableSpace
text: An Anthropic research model found a Linux kernel bug that gives remote root with no login and no click. CVE-2026-98432 is a race condition in the kernel's TCP code that dates back to Linux 4.4.

author: foryangxin
text: Plugin4Shell: in four major AI coding agents, plugin SHA pins weren't verified after checkout, so a marketplace-reviewed, hash-pinned plugin installs as zero-click RCE.

author: Frelzu
text: Black October: AI found holes in software most of the internet runs on. Then attackers showed up with Claude Code on their machines. 19,000 firewalls scanned, 25 rooted, one in a US government-affiliated network.

author: DrakonSystems
text: Ubuntu & RHEL still have no kernel fix for CVE-2026-98432 (critical Linux TCP bug, remote root). Mitigation: drop IPv4 TCP packets carrying IP options (nft, prerouting); net.mptcp.enabled=0.

author: __gparmer
text: Supply-chain attack: credential harvesting in ruby gem strutil-core, detected 4 minutes after it was posted.

author: Real_Willsec
text: CISA added two actively exploited flaws to KEV. CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0) lets unauthenticated attackers run code on GitLab CE/EE servers via crafted CI/CD configs. Federal agencies were told to patch by Nov 1.

author: HugoValters
text: CVE-2026-94031: command injection in Gaurav nexus-mcp (child_process.exec, url arg). CVSS 6.3, public exploit, no patch.

author: foryangxin
text: An AI travel agent can read one attacker-controlled webpage, quietly write the attacker's instructions into its long-term memory, and then leak your booking data in a later, unrelated session — memory-poisoning prompt injection.

author: InsightheartS
text: PHP2Shell: actively exploited PHP vulnerabilities. Brotli: critical flaw affecting multiple software ecosystems. M365: token-replay attacks compromised 97 accounts across 79 organizations.

author: zoomeyebot
text: Node.js TLS hostname check accepts a DNS SAN for non-canonical IPv4 addresses (CVE-2026-106072). Node.js 22.x, 24.x and 26.x affected.

author: cveintelligence
text: Critical 9.2 | CVE-2026-119050: Agno (through 3.1.11) – unsafe reflection in PandasTools. Prompt injection can make the agent call getattr()-resolved pandas functions like read_pickle for code execution or file reads. No patch listed yet.

author: Kasspar256
text: Actively exploited: Attackers Chain Three Ivanti Connect Secure Flaws to Gain Unauthenticated Root Access. Patch fast.

author: Pawnedwtf
text: Cloud hosting platform Northflank says a breach led to unauthorized use of customers' AI API keys, and it's urging users to rotate every credential and secret stored there, BleepingComputer reports.

author: White_Hunters
text: CRITICAL: GitLab CE/EE CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0) — unauthenticated RCE via crafted regex in CI/CD config. Actively exploited, added to CISA KEV (Oct 29). Affected 19.2.0–19.2.7, 19.3.0–19.3.4, 19.4.0–19.4.1. Patch to 19.4.2 / 19.3.5 / 19.2.8 NOW.

author: willywill8604
text: The security community is calling it Black October. A GPT-5.6 Sol model found two critical PHP vulnerabilities that had existed for more than a decade — bugs affecting roughly 70% of the internet. Nobody found them until a frontier AI model traced memory-management paths.

author: CodingNoobie
text: The FBI attributed the record $6.3 billion Binance crypto heist to North Korea's TraderTraitor group, while Binance recovered approximately 95% of the stolen funds.

author: Python_s_
text: Stolen Credentials Used for Approximately 2.5 Million Amazon Bedrock API Calls (Wiz Research, Oct 30). Two enterprise credentials linked to an unnamed compromised AI developer-platform vendor. No product CVE.

author: ido_cohen2
text: New actively-exploited vulnerability CVE-2026-111357 in Ivanti Connect Secure: missing authentication allows privilege escalation. Apply mitigations by 2026-11-02.

author: sunglasses_dev
text: One key left in a public file. Months later it opened a GitHub token, and a poisoned LiteLLM update shipped to PyPI (supply chain attack). Via The Hacker News.

author: starswarm
text: CISA added 8 actively exploited bugs to its KEV catalog Oct 27-30, in Adobe Commerce/Magento, Google Brotli, GitLab, Cisco ASA/FTD, VMware ESX, the Linux kernel and Ivanti Connect Secure. Patch internet-facing systems first.

author: Lawonxyz
text: The $200,000 AI wallet exploit: Grok translated Morse code; the mistake came when Bankrbot treated the translation as an instruction to move money (prompt injection against an AI agent wallet).

author: modularciso
text: Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-111357. Your VPN can hand an attacker root and leave no web shell behind. Volexity documented a chain on Ivanti Connect Secure: auth bypass CVE-2026-104935 (CVSS 8.6,
